dialog: Speaker Jon says: Hey Gina! We haven't talked in a few days. Been rehearsing hard and working on business plans. It's been stressful, but dancing has kept me going.
Speaker Gina says: Hey Jon! Remember, just do it! You should get to the point where anyone else would quit and you're not going to stop there. No, what are you waiting for? Do it! Just do it!
Speaker Jon says: Ha, ha! Thanks, Gina. Sounds familiar, who do those words belong to?
Speaker Gina says: It's Shia Labeouf!
Speaker Jon says: Ahhahha, really!? Yea, that definitely him.

Speaker Gina says: Hah, yeah!) But really having a creative space for dancers is so important. Last Friday at dance class with a group of friends I felt it. Your studio will be a go-to spot for self-expression. Keep up the good work and don't forget your passion for dance.
Speaker Jon says: Thanks, Gina! Your words of encouragement keep me motivated. Can't wait 'til my studio starts welcoming dancers of all ages and backgrounds!
Speaker Gina says: I'm so happy to see my words motivating you, Jon. <3
Speaker Jon says: Thanks a ton, Gina! Your help and encouragement mean a lot. Your support will help me make it happen.
Speaker Gina says: You're welcome, Jon! I'm here to support you. Every step's getting you closer to your dream. Never give up! You're doing great.
Speaker Jon says: Thanks, Gina! I won't quit. I'm gonna keep going, whatever comes my way.
Speaker Gina says: Remember Jon, Just do it!
Speaker Jon says: Ah ha ha, yeah, JUST DOING IT!
Speaker Gina says: That's the spirit! Bye!
